candidates.original_title: Millionaire Migration and State Taxation of Top Incomes: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
candidates.description: The effect of New Jersey's 2004 income tax increase on net out-migration of millionaires among taxpayers earning all income in New Jersey
candidates.citation_sentence: This comment revisits an article by Cristobal Young and Charles Varner (2011; henceforth, YV) in the National Tax Journal that examined the extent to which a tax increase spurred net out-migration of high-income taxpayers from New Jersey.
candidates.notes: The paper reestimates YV's models with multiple specifications; the key finding is that excluding in-migrants reveals a statistically significant increase in millionaire out-migration that YV's net migration specification missed due to methodological issues (including in-migrants in the sample). Replication of YV's model 5 (table 3), limiting the sample to affluent taxpayers who reported earning all of their income in New Jersey in a given year; confirms YV's finding of a statistically significant coefficient (2.47) at the 10 percent level.

candidates.original_title: Millionaire Migration and State Taxation of Top Incomes: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
candidates.description: The effect of New Jersey's 2004 income tax increase on net out-migration of millionaires relative to other affluent taxpayers
candidates.citation_sentence: This comment revisits an article by Cristobal Young and Charles Varner (2011; henceforth, YV) in the National Tax Journal that examined the extent to which a tax increase spurred net out-migration of high-income taxpayers from New Jersey.
candidates.notes: Reestimation of YV's models 1-3 (table 1, net migration specification) using the same methodology; authors report coefficients very similar to YV's, reproducing the null finding. [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Millionaire Migration and State Taxation of Top Incomes: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
candidates.description: The effect of New Jersey's 2004 income tax increase on net out-migration of millionaires relative to other affluent taxpayers
candidates.citation_sentence: This comment revisits an article by Cristobal Young and Charles Varner (2011; henceforth, YV) in the National Tax Journal that examined the extent to which a tax increase spurred net out-migration of high-income taxpayers from New Jersey.
candidates.notes: Reestimation of YV's model excluding New Jersey in-migrants (out-migration specification, table 2 sections C-D); finds statistically significant increase in annual millionaire out-migration after 2003, with coefficient roughly five times larger than YV's highlighted net migration estimates.
